text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest overnight gains, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite risk-off conditions. The Fear & Greed Index at 29 reflects genuine caution, and the 5-point weekly decline signals deepening pessimism rather than stabilization. Bitcoin's dominance holding above 59% paired with $65B in daily volume indicates traders are consolidating around the major pairs while uncertainty persists.
